slides.title: Concept: What is a Prompt?
content: Imagine asking a smart friend for help.
A prompt is your instruction to an AI chatbot.
AI chatbots understand text and generate responses.
narration: Let's start by understanding what a prompt is.
Imagine asking a smart friend for help.
You would give them a question or instruction. [Pause]
This question or instruction, given to an AI chatbot, is called a 'prompt'.
AI chatbots understand your typed text.
They then generate a reply or complete a task.
slides.image_prompt: A cheerful person talking to a friendly, cartoon AI robot. A speech bubble above the person shows text input, and a speech bubble above the robot shows text output.

slides.title: Why Prompting Matters
content: Specific request: "Give me a red cotton saree for a wedding."
Good prompts give useful, targeted results.
Saves time and helps with daily tasks.
narration: Why is learning to prompt important? Let's use an example.
If you ask a shopkeeper, "Give me something nice," you might get anything. [Pause]
But if you ask for "a red cotton saree for a wedding",
then you get exactly what you need.
Prompting is similar. A good prompt gives useful and targeted results.
This saves your time and helps you with many daily tasks.
So, precise prompting leads to precise results.
slides.image_prompt: A split image. On one side, a confused person at a shop with a vague thought bubble. On the other side, a satisfied person with a specific thought bubble, receiving the exact item.

slides.title: Core Concept 1: Be Clear and Specific
content: Specific: "Tell me about main festivals in India."
Use exact words, avoid vague terms.
Add details to narrow the topic.
narration: Our first core concept for good prompts is: Be Clear and Specific.
Asking an AI chatbot, "Tell me about India," is too broad.
It will give lots of general information. [Pause]
Instead, ask, "Tell me about the main festivals celebrated in India."
This is specific. Use exact words and avoid vague terms.
Add details that narrow down your topic. This helps the AI give you relevant information.
slides.image_prompt: A funnel graphic. Broad terms like 'information' are at the wide top. Specific terms like 'main festivals in India' are at the narrow bottom, illustrating clarity.

slides.title: Core Concept 2: Give Context and Role
content: With Context: "I am a 7th-grade student. Explain photosynthesis simply."
Tell the AI its role (e.g., teacher, expert).
Tell the AI your role (e.g., student, parent).
Explain your goal for the information.
narration: Our second core concept is: Give Context and Role.
If you ask, "Explain photosynthesis," the AI might give a very scientific answer. [Pause]
But if you say, "I am a 7th-grade student. Explain photosynthesis to me simply,"
the AI adjusts its language. Tell the AI what 'role' to play and who *you* are.
Also, explain your goal. This helps the AI tailor its answer.
Your goal is to help the AI understand you.
This ensures the AI tailors its answer correctly.
slides.image_prompt: An AI chatbot icon surrounded by thought bubbles containing different roles like 'teacher', 'student', 'expert'. Arrows show how the AI output changes based on the given context and role.

slides.title: Summary of Good Prompting
content: Prompt: Your instruction to an AI chatbot.
narration: Let's quickly summarise what we have learned.
A prompt is your instruction to an AI chatbot.
To get good answers, your prompts must be clear and specific. [Pause]
Always give context and a role. This helps the AI understand your needs.
Also, specify the format and length for easy-to-use output.
Remember, practice makes you better! We covered three key concepts today.
Mastering these will improve your AI interactions.
slides.image_prompt: A visually appealing infographic or list showing the three key tips for good prompting: 'Clear & Specific' (magnifying glass icon), 'Context & Role' (two people icon), 'Format & Length' (ruler icon).

slides.title: Assignment: Plan a Local Trip
content: Scenario: Plan a one-day, low-budget trip for two friends within 50 km of your city.
Task: Write ONE effective prompt for an AI chatbot.
- Desired output format (e.g., numbered list of places, activities, food).

Example (do not copy directly, try your own first!): "I am planning a fun, low-budget one-day trip with two friends this weekend. We want to stay within 50 km of our city. Please act as a local travel guide and suggest three different places we can visit. For each place, suggest two activities and one simple food option. Present the information as a numbered list."
narration: Here is a small assignment to practice your prompting skills. [Pause]
Imagine you want to plan a fun, low-budget one-day trip for two friends.
The trip should be to a place within 50 kilometres of your city.
Your task is to write ONE effective prompt for an AI chatbot. [Pause]
Use all the skills you learned.
Include specific details, your role, and the desired output format.
For example, a numbered list of places, activities, and food options.
Try it out with an AI chatbot! Take your time to craft the best prompt.
Good luck with your local trip planning!
